questions: What is the range of the G700
How far can the jet fly
answer: The Gulfstream G700 has a maximum range of 7,500 nautical miles (13,890 km) at Mach 0.85. This enables non-stop travel between city pairs such as New York to Tokyo, London to Singapore, or Dubai to Los Angeles — without a fuel stop.

The G700 cruises at Mach 0.90 (long-range cruise) and reaches a maximum operating speed of Mach 0.925. In practical terms, this is approximately 621 mph (1,000 km/h) — making it one of the fastest ultra-long-range business jets available.

questions: How many passengers can it carry
answer: The G700 can accommodate up to 19 passengers in a typical configuration. The standard cabin layout features between 13 and 17 seats across four living areas, offering exceptional space and privacy for long-haul travel.

questions: What does the interior look like
answer: The G700 cabin spans 56 feet and is divided into up to five distinct living areas — typically a forward lounge, dining area, meeting zone, aft lounge, and a private stateroom. Standard features include full-flat beds, Bose noise-canceling headsets, a galley kitchen, satellite WiFi, 4K entertainment displays, and air pressure maintained at a comfortable 3,600-foot cabin altitude.

questions: What exterior paint colors are available
what paint options can I choose
answer: In the Aether configurator, you can select from premium exterior paint finishes including Pearl White, Midnight Black, Platinum Silver, and Champagne Gold. Each finish is applied over an aerospace-grade primer and protected by a high-gloss or satin clear coat for exceptional durability and UV resistance.

questions: What seat upholstery options are available
what leather colors can I choose
answer: The configurator offers several seat upholstery collections: Full Leather in Ivory, Cognac, Slate, and Obsidian; as well as Alcantara Suede in Dune and Charcoal. Each material is sourced from European tanneries and tailored to aerospace safety standards.

questions: What wood trim options are available
answer: Aether offers five exquisite wood trim veneers: American Walnut with a satin finish, Dark Mahogany with a high-gloss lacquer, Pale Ash with a natural matte, Ebony with a piano gloss, and Carbon Weave — a contemporary alternative to traditional veneer. All panels are hand-fitted and bookmatched.

questions: What ambient lighting options are available
what cabin light colors can I choose
answer: The G700 features a full-cabin LED lighting system with tunable color and intensity. Through the Aether configurator, you can select from Warm White (a soft 2700K glow), Cool White (crisp 5000K daylight), Amber (a warm golden tone), Blue Sky (a calming blue-white), Twilight Rose, and Emerald — each tunable in brightness to create the ideal atmosphere.

questions: What floor material options are available
answer: The cabin floor can be configured with two premium finishes: Natural — a warm blonde toned wood-plank style composite — and Dark, a deep espresso finish. Both are engineered for aerospace applications, offering soft underfoot feel with structural rigidity and ease of maintenance.

questions: What metal finish options are available
answer: Three curated metal finishes are available for cabin hardware, fixtures, and accent trim: Metal A — a polished brushed nickel; Metal B — a satin gold / champagne tone; and Metal C — a dark oil-rubbed bronze. These apply to galley fixtures, seat armrest trim, window surrounds, and door hardware.

questions: What surface finish options are available
answer: The exterior paint can be finished in Gloss (mirror-bright, the classic choice for maximum visual impact), Satin (an elegant semi-matte with a soft sheen), or Matte (a contemporary ultra-flat finish that absorbs light for a stealthy, bespoke look). Gloss is the most durable for maintenance in long-range operations.

questions: Can I add an accent stripe
answer: Yes — the Aether configurator offers three accent stripe options: no stripe (clean minimalist look), a Classic Gold pinstripe along the fuselage waterline, and a Dual Silver split-stripe for a sportier profile. Stripes are painted before the clear coat application for a seamless integrated finish.

questions: How much does the G700 cost
answer: A new Gulfstream G700 has a base list price of approximately $78 million USD. Final pricing varies significantly based on your customisation choices, delivery timeline, and any additional options such as connectivity packages, enhanced galley, or bespoke interior elements. questions: How long is the delivery wait time
how long to get the jet
answer: Current Gulfstream G700 delivery lead times are approximately 2 to 3 years from the date of contract signing, due to high demand. Aether can assist with expedited options including pre-owned G700 acquisitions with delivery in as little as 60 days, or interim fractional charter arrangements while you await delivery.

questions: How do I use the configurator
how do I customise my jet
answer: The Aether configurator is intuitive to use. On the right-side panel, select 'Exterior' or 'Interior' using the toggle at the top, then browse each material category — paint, trim, upholstery, lighting and more. Click any option card to apply it instantly in 3D. On mobile, swipe up the bottom sheet to expand the panel. Drag the 3D view to orbit, scroll to zoom.

questions: How do I rotate the view
how to orbit around the jet
answer: To navigate the 3D view: drag with your left mouse button (or one finger on touch) to orbit around the aircraft. Scroll your mouse wheel (or pinch with two fingers) to zoom in and out. Right-click and drag (or two-finger drag on touch) to pan the view. Press the reset button in the top-right to return to the default camera angle.

questions: How do I switch between exterior and interior
answer: Use the 'Exterior / Interior' pill toggle at the top centre of the screen to switch between the two views. In Exterior mode you can configure paint, stripe, and surface finish. In Interior mode you can personalise the seat upholstery, wood trim, floor, metal accents, cabin plastic, and ambient lighting.

questions: how is the air quality on board
does the cabin feel comfortable at cruise altitude
answer: The G700 maintains a cabin altitude of just 3,600 feet when cruising at 51,000 feet — industry-leading pressurisation that significantly reduces fatigue and jet lag. The air is 100% fresh (not recirculated), humidity-controlled, and Gulfstream's Ultraflex windows admit ample natural light while blocking UV radiation.

questions: can I work on the jet
answer: Yes — the G700 supports Ka-band and Ku-band satellite internet providing broadband speeds comparable to a good home connection. The system supports HD video conferencing, live streaming, and seamless voice calls. A comprehensive avionics suite also includes SATCOM voice and text communication independent of passenger WiFi.

questions: How fuel efficient is the G700
what is the fuel burn rate
how much fuel does it use
answer: The G700 is powered by two Rolls-Royce Pearl 700 engines, each producing 18,250 lbs of thrust with best-in-class fuel efficiency for its range category. Typical fuel burn at long-range cruise is approximately 280 gallons per hour per engine. With a fuel capacity of 8,800 gallons, the aircraft achieves its 7,500 nm range capability.

questions: How many crew members are required
how many pilots does the G700 need
answer: The G700 requires two pilots for all operations. The Symmetry Flight Deck features side-stick controllers and the most advanced avionics in business aviation. For long-range international flights, operators typically carry an augmented crew of three or four pilots. One or two cabin attendants are usually included to manage the galley and passenger comfort.

questions: What runway length does the G700 need
what airports can the G700 use
answer: The G700 requires approximately 6,000 feet (1,829 m) of runway for a standard maximum takeoff weight departure — giving it access to most major international airports. At lighter loads it can operate from shorter runways around 5,200 feet, opening up access to secondary airports closer to your final destination.

questions: how much does it cost to operate per year
answer: Total annual operating costs for a G700 used approximately 400 hours per year are typically in the range of $4.5 to $6 million USD. This includes fuel, crew salaries, maintenance, hangar, insurance, and management fees. Variable costs (primarily fuel) run roughly $6,000 to $8,000 per flight hour depending on fuel prices and route conditions.

questions: Does the G700 have a bedroom
answer: Yes — the aft section of the G700 can be configured as a private stateroom with a full-flat double bed. The partition between the stateroom and main cabin provides true privacy. The bed converts from a club seating arrangement, and the area includes dedicated wardrobe storage, nightstands, and mood lighting controls.

questions: What kitchen facilities are on board
can a chef cook on board
answer: The G700 features a fully equipped forward galley with a full-size oven, convection microwave, espresso machine, refrigerator, wine chiller, and ample storage for catering supplies. A dedicated galley attendant station allows a professional chef to prepare multi-course meals at altitude — with an equipment spec that rivals a fine-restaurant kitchen.

questions: what safety certifications does it have
answer: The Gulfstream G700 is fully certified by the FAA, EASA, and multiple international aviation authorities. It exceeds all current safety requirements and features redundant systems throughout — dual hydraulics, triple avionics buses, automatic envelope protection, and synthetic vision. Business aviation consistently records the highest safety standards in commercial aviation.

The G700 features 20 panoramic oval windows — the largest in its class at 28 x 20 inches — flooding the cabin with exceptional natural light. Electrochromatic dimming shades eliminate traditional pull-down blinds, allowing electronic control of light intensity with a simple touch. The windows also incorporate Gulfstream's UV-blocking technology.

questions: What cabin plastic options are there
answer: The cabin plastic panels — covering sidewalls, overhead bins, and partition dividers — are available in Light (a warm off-white that maximises the sense of space), and Dark (a deep charcoal tone for a more dramatic, intimate atmosphere). Both finishes are UV-stable and can be matched to your chosen wood and upholstery palette.

how to return to default view
go back to original camera position
